messages:
matt_csm: Quick weekly check — Juno account (onboarding wk7). Sharing token + throughput snapshot, flagged spend jump and a latency uptick.

jessica_cs: TL;DR — tokens WoW +45%, QoQ +12%. P95 latency up to 180ms (was 140ms). Error rate ~0.9% (mostly gateway 5xx). Spend WoW +62%.

luca_data: Raw numbers below:
```
Avg daily tokens: 42.3M (WoW +45%, QoQ +12%)
Peak throughput: 280 RPS (sustained ~90s)
P95 latency: 180ms
Error rate: 0.9% (5xx dominant)
Daily spend: $1,800 (WoW +62%)
Session length median: 14k tokens
Cache hit rate: 72% (down from 88% last week)
```

anika_eng: Noting cache hit drop + longer seq lengths -> batching/eviction pressure. Planning a short cache-ttl bump and a KV-prefetch experiment. Will post results.

sam_ops: Opened ticket CS-4732 -> infra + runtime. Also scheduled a small canary (TTL +10s) at 15:30 PT today. If stable, we roll to prod. @anika_eng can you confirm the canary window?

anika_eng: Confirmed. Canary 15:30-16:00 PT. I'll attach perf traces.

jessica_cs: Customer reported intermittent "generation lagging" and occasional 502s. Sent KB on streaming + recommended model params (lower max_tokens, enable streaming). Offered 1:1 enablement next Tue.

matt_csm: Immediate owner-action list:
- Anika: run TTL canary & share traces (ETA 1h)
- Sam: set temporary spend cap alert + protect plan (finance loop)
- Jess: schedule enablement session + capture CS feedback in playbook
- Luca: keep token QoQ trend on radar, prepare chart for renewal call
Also tagging @alerts_bot to watch error rate >1.5%.

alerts_bot: Watch created: juno-prod errors >1.5% -> notify #eng-oncall and #customer-success.

jessica_cs: Renewal risk: medium-low. High usage is positive but UX friction + spend jump are negotiation points. Will include quantization/batching recommendations in renewal doc to offset spend.

matt_csm: Good. We'll update customer post-canary. If canary reduces P95 to <160ms and error <0.5%, we mark health => green. Otherwise escalate to Dedicated capacity discussion.

jessica_cs: Noted. Adding enablement invite now.

matt_csm: End of check-in — ping me if anything changes before 16:30 PT.
